description: This Java class implements an interactive Android Wear OS watch face service, allowing touch events such as tap, touch, and cancel to be registered and displayed, demonstrating the watch face's interactive capabilities.

classes.name: InteractiveWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService to create an interactive watch face.

classes.name: InteractiveWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handling rendering and touch events for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Engine instance for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes paint objects, registers tap events, and sets style.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout parameters based on device shape (round or square).

methods.name: onPeekCardPositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates layout for peek card position.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Handles property changes such as burn-in protection and low-bit ambient.

methods.name: onTapCommand
methods.description: Handles tap events, counting taps, cancels, and touches, updating displayed counts and coordinates.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the background and text displaying tap and touch event counts and coordinates, and covers peek card area.
